subject: Infra review: dedicated GPU capacity, autoscale & isolation — roundtable

Cc: cloudscale-sales@cloudscale.com
Date: Sun, 18 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: dedicated GPU capacity architecture review (FinTech Labs)

Hi Connor,

Thanks for taking time here — we are nearing a decision window for our dedicated deployment and need a focused technical review on pool sizing, autoscale behavior under bursty load, and tenant isolation patterns. Our infra lead (cc'd CloudScale rep) will join.

Goal: make sure we have the right pool topology and fallback strategy before we commit to reserved capacity.

High-level agenda I proposed:
- Current workload profile + peak/median token throughput (we'll attach)
- Pool sizing recommendations (mixed-precision / quantization tradeoffs)
- Autoscale policies and cold-start behavior
- Isolation strategies (VM vs. tenant-level, preemption handling)
- Next steps / mutual action items

Proposed slots: Tue 4/20 11:00–12:00 PT or Wed 4/21 09:00–10:00 PT. We can be flexible.

I attached a short pre-read and a draft capacity matrix. Let me know which slot works and who from Redwood should attend.

Thanks,
Sandra
Sandra Lee
Head of Infrastructure
FinTech Labs

Hi Sandra — great summary, thanks.

We should definitely cover those agenda items. Proposed attendees from Redwood:
- Connor O'Brien (Dedicated capacity lead)
- Marissa Cole (Capacity/ops)
- Karthik Iyer (Runtime architecture)
- Grace O'Connor (Customer reliability) — joining if available

Between the two slots you suggested, Tue 4/20 11:00–12:00 PT works best for our team. I’ll send a calendar invite and include a short pre-read from our side outlining our autoscale knob recommendations.

A few prep asks to make the discussion efficient:
1) Can you include the 95/99 token-per-second percentiles and a recent 24h spike window in the pre-read?
2) Any compliance requirements around tenant isolation (e.g., dedicated host requirement, encryption-at-rest policies) we should be aware of?
3) Are you expecting an architecture decision on quantization (INT8 vs FP16) in this meeting? If so, flag it and we’ll bring the runtime quantization owner.

If we need to push, Marissa flagged a conflicting all-hands on Tue afternoon; I’ll confirm before finalizing the invite.

—Connor
